headline: Approved contracts including $11,692,041.56 Wastewater Treatment Facility Phase I construction and $207,490 fire rescue physicals
summary: The Finance Committee approved multiple contracts and purchases, including health physicals for Nashua Fire Rescue, a municipal tractor, copier leases, internet and software agreements, engineering services for the Heritage Rail Trail, and wastewater treatment facility upgrades. The committee also confirmed compliance with expenditure record requirements for September 11 through October 1, 2026.
decisions: Approved a contract with United Diagnostic Services, LLC for health and safety physicals for 185 members of Nashua Fire Rescue, not to exceed $207,490.
Approved purchase of a Trackless MT7 Municipal Tractor T4F from C.N. Wood Enviro, LLC, not to exceed $252,064.50.
Approved a copier lease and maintenance contract with Toshiba Financial Services, not to exceed $35,220.
Approved a 12-month renewal contract with Business Information Systems Consulting, Inc., dba ClearSky Consulting, for remote application management support, not to exceed $90,000.
Approved a 36-month extension contract with Fidium Enterprise Services, LLC for the city's primary internet service, not to exceed $29,484.
Approved a 3-year contract with SHI International Corp. for the Microsoft Software Assurance Program, not to exceed $68,310.08.
Approved Amendment #4 to the engineering services contract with CMA Engineers, Inc. for the Nashua Heritage Rail Trail East Project, not to exceed $23,362.
Approved a work agreement with Eversource for replacement of city-owned electrical equipment on Eversource-owned poles, not to exceed $29,595.02.
Approved a contract with Loureiro Building Construction, LLC for the Wastewater Treatment Facility Phase I Upgrade construction, contingent on bond funding approval, not to exceed $11,692,041.56.
Approved a contract with Wright Pierce for construction administration services for the Phase I Upgrade Project, not to exceed $1,361,000.
Approved Change Order #1 with N.E. Mobile Audio for a dedicated control tablet and multi-angle camera system at Renaissance Park, not to exceed $3,597.00.
Approved Amendment #1 with Above The Rest Inspections to include testing of lead dust wipes, not to exceed $150,000.
Approved that the Finance Committee has complied with the City Charter and ordinances for the record of expenditures from September 11, 2026 through October 1, 2026.
